svg.text: From the first alert to lessons learned: what each product does, and what crosses between them
Smith and analysts flag rows: lead first
each one cited: host, artefact, ref, SHA-256
and a Navigator layer of the case
incident or hunt, severity, TLP, code name
tasks, playbooks on the anatomy, clocks
a group, a CVE or techniques
runs a hunt's queries; keeps counts only
to the SIEM; emulation through VECTR
paired: an ostraka-scope token, a signed webhook
reads cases and rows; starts jobs on its evidence
finding.confirmed arrives as a lead, once
job.completed is noted on the record
paired: an ostraka-scope token, a signed webhook
confirmed techniques without detections: gap tasks
starts hunt runs; Shikari runs their queries
a count per query comes back, never a row
only with servers on the organisation's network:
requests carry identifiers, never the record
STIX, MISP, Navigator, SIEM clients, netguard
desktop apps or a team server, homelab
behind Tailscale; install-suite for all three
